description: cc-nexs preset-standard hooks: 角色边界、Git Custodian 边界与合并主干前置检查。人工 gate 由状态机暂停实现，不封锁通用工具。

hooks.command: node -e "const p=require('node:path'),u=require('node:url'),r=process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.CC_NEXS_PLUGIN_ROOT;if(!r){console.error('[cc-nexs hook] plugin root is unavailable');process.exit(1)}import(u.pathToFileURL(p.join(r,'hooks','role-boundary-guard.mjs')).href).catch(e=>{console.error('[cc-nexs hook] bootstrap failed: '+e.message);process.exit(1)})"
